# axiom_user_role (Resource)

Manages the base role of an existing user, for example a user provisioned through single sign-on. Unlike `axiom_user`, this resource doesn't invite or remove the user. Destroying it leaves the user's current role unchanged. Don't manage the same user's role with both `axiom_user` and `axiom_user_role`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "axiom_users" "all" {}

resource "axiom_user_role" "alice" {
  user_id = one([for u in data.axiom_users.all.users : u.id if u.email == "alice@example.com"])
  role    = "none"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Base role of the user: `none`, `read-only`, `user`, `admin`, `owner`, or the ID of an `axiom_role`. Use `none` when the user should only receive access through groups. An API token can't set or remove the `owner` role.
- `user_id` (String) User identifier

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `user_id`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import axiom_user_role.alice <user-id>
```
